svg.aria-label: Visual abstract: RR (horizontal) against no difference (vertical reference line), showing the pooled estimate and its confidence interval
svg.text: Apixaban for the treatment of venous thromboembolism: eight trials report
an outcome named for recurrent VTE, and three of them count the same thing
In adults with acute or recent venous thromboembolism, what is the effect of apixaban
compared with conventional anticoagulation, another direct oral anticoagulant, or placebo on
recurrent venous thromboembolism and on bleeding?
The interval INCLUDES no difference: this pooled estimate is compatible with no effect.
3 trials, 3,933 participants. Outcome: Recurrent symptomatic venous thromboembolism -- nonfatal deep
vein thrombosis or nonfatal pulmonary embolism -- with NO death term. GRADE certainty: Pending.
Leave-one-out: no refit excludes no difference; the estimate does not survive removal of any single
